//: Every way of leaving a session, mapped to what MAID defines today with the shipped leave table (docs/settings.md#leaving-a-session, docs/design/engine-protocol.md 'As built (the leave table)'), or to UNDEFINED where nothing defines it. scripts/leave_audit.py expands every combination of the dimensions and gives each the first rule whose `when` fits it (a value or a list per dimension; a dimension left out fits any value). `is` is the behaviour, "n/a: ..." for a combination that cannot happen, or "UNDEFINED" with `why`; `same_as` maps the combination to the one with those dimensions replaced, with `prefix` before its behaviour. A window is one interface (a TUI, a maid.nvim tab), each its own client.

rules.is: n/a: a foreground subagent exists only inside its parent's running turn, so the session left is never idle while it runs
n/a: --park and --stop interrupt the turn, so nothing is left to finish

n/a: one engine per transcript: without the daemon each window runs its own engine, and a second one is refused a session another has open (its transcript is held), so no session has two windows there
refused (maid_step_up_required), nothing changed: a remote flag that loosens the case (stop -> park -> bg) needs a step-up, which waits for accounts (roadmap item 6)
refused (maid_step_up_required), nothing changed: a remote flag that loosens the case (stop -> park -> bg) needs a step-up, which waits for accounts (roadmap item 6)
n/a: without a daemon a quit parks or stops what still runs (leave.no_daemon), so nothing finishes after it

rules.prefix: its parent's, whose turn carries it:
its own case, nothing from its parent (a task is its own session):

rules.is: keeps working in the background (leave.switch.working: bg, shipped), with its own leave.task.after armed
keeps working where sessions outlive their clients (leave.quit.working: bg, shipped), with its own leave.task.after armed
leave.task.after: parked once its work ends with no window on it, whichever way it was left (shipped park, the same as switch.after), shown finished, parked

rules.prefix: as any session (a task is switched to, parked and stopped like one):

rules.is: left alone: another window still has it in focus, so the case does not apply and no after is armed
this window lets go of it; it stays live in the other window

rules.prefix: under the other window too (a flag does not leave it alone):

rules.is: leave.switch.idle: parked (shipped); bg keeps it loaded, ask asks (b/p/s, vim.ui.select)
stays loaded in the background, idle
parked: out of memory, in the switcher, resumes where it was
stopped: off the switcher, an ordinary transcript (maid -r)
keeps working in the background (leave.switch.working: bg, shipped), with leave.switch.after armed
asked first, then its turn is interrupted and it is parked
asked first, then its turn is interrupted and it is stopped
leave.switch.after: parked once its work ends with no window on it, shown finished, parked
leave.quit.idle: stopped (shipped); ask asks at quit (b/p/s, vim.ui.select), and a client that goes unasked gets the shipped stop
leave.no_daemon: parked, since no daemon keeps it
stays loaded, idle, where sessions outlive their clients (the daemon, maid-server)
leave.no_daemon: its turn is interrupted and it is parked
keeps working where sessions outlive their clients (leave.quit.working: bg, shipped), with leave.quit.after armed
leave.quit.after: parked once its work is done
